readout_other: laser speckle contrast imaging of cortical blood flow; time to first movement and full movement (righting reflex); H&E staining
direction_notes: 5 min TUS to CA1 immediately after 120 min isoflurane anaesthesia accelerated recovery of cortical blood flow and shortened time to first movement; TUS during prolonged anaesthesia did not accelerate recovery.
safety_notes: H&E staining showed no signs of microhemorrhage, edema, or cell necrosis in exposed areas; theoretical temperature rise estimated below 0.01 C.

timing.protocol_description: 1 s sonications with 4 s inter-stimulus interval, delivered for 5 min to CA1; given after (main experiment) or during isoflurane anaesthesia, or after 60 min anaesthesia in a short-anaesthesia comparison.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: For mice in the US group, a 5-min ultrasound stimulation was applied to the CA1 region (ML: −2 mm, AP: 2 mm).
